pr_body:
This missing member came up during the API review for CborWriter.

I'm working on a followup change to find blocks like

```C#
EnsureCapacityOfSomeSorts(writer.GetEncodedLength())
if (!writer.TryEncode(destination, out int bytesWritten))
{
    Debug.Fail(...);
    ...
}
```

and replace them with

```C#
EnsureCapacityOfSomeSorts(writer.GetEncodedLength())
int bytesWritten = writer.Encode(destination);
```

It'll also include doing the same for IncrementalHash.GetHashAndReset(span), once that change lands.

Fixes #37987.

review_comments: Perhaps using `Assert.Equal(dest.ToArray(), encoded.ToArray())` might be better in identifying errors?

Assuming that the array mismatch pretty-printer has been fixed to show where the error was (it used to always show the first N elements, even if the error was beyond N), yeah -- or ByteArrayToHex.  In this case, `encoded` was already compared using a nice-to-diagnose flow, and the other variants are using one that's a little nicer on the GC since failure isn't expected -- once that burns me it'll change.  (This complex routine is run for every single writer output-producing test case)
